about_the_game:
The year is 1900. Off the coast of Scotland, all contact has been lost with the lighthouse on the remote island of Eilean Mor. The light no longer shines at night. No one is answering the radio. And the three lighthouse keepers have vanished without a trace.

You are a reserve lighthouse keeper, sent to investigate the silence. What begins as a simple relief mission soon descends into a psychological horror experience one rooted in isolation, madness, and a mystery buried deep within the island.

Explore dark halls, uncover cryptic clues, and survive the haunting atmosphere of Eilean Mor in this story-rich, first-person horror adventure. As the fog thickens and reality begins to unravel, you must uncover the truth before you too disappear into the dark.

REAL STORY

James D., Thomas M., Donald M.

In December of the year 1900…

Three men were stationed on the island of Eilean Mòr.

And on December 7th, they sent their final signal to the outside world.

Then… darkness fell. And the lighthouse… was never lit again.

For 19 days, there was no sign, no trace. Until Joseph M. the relief keeper, set foot on the island.

What he found was more terrifying than silence. There was no sign of life.

The lighthouse was abandoned. And inside… only a logbook remained.

"The strongest wind I’ve seen in 20 years. Head Keeper James D. has gone quiet, and the third assistant McArthur is crying."

But the records show… there was no storm that day.

So… what was it that drove three seasoned men to tears in fear?

What could have pulled them outside… into the cold… without even taking their coats?

In the year 1900, at an ordinary lighthouse…

Something extraordinary happened.

Are you ready... for the terror?

THEME

The story in the game is inspired and adapted from a real event.It takes place at a lighthouse located on a remote island. The island and lighthouse are designed based on a real-world location.

GAMEPLAY

This is a single-player, first-person horror and thriller game.
Don’t forget that you need to follow certain clues to progress in the game.

CONTENT WARNING

This game contains jump scares, disturbing atmospheres, and psychological horror elements. It is not recommended for individuals with heart conditions, a history of epilepsy, or those who are pregnant. Please proceed with caution while playing.
